# Access Control

| Role     | Can View | Can Edit | Notes            |
|----------|----------|----------|------------------|
| Reviewer | ✅        | ❌        | View only        |
| Admin    | ✅        | ✅        | Full permissions |
| Observer | ✅        | ❌        | Read-only        |
